bootstrap.unit: casefolded homonym with all families, versions and votes kept together

equivalence.statistic: model minus human, mean absolute signed ending change in grade units

nonsensical_votes: include all votes in primary analysis; repeat with flagged votes removed for sensitivity
primary: mean absolute error of same-sense signed ending changes
primary_contrast: ending minus common_prefix, paired 95% upper bounds below zero for both measures

semeval_secondary.accuracy: strictly inside human mean ± sample SD or absolute difference < 1
semeval_secondary.point_readout: round expected grade to nearest integer, half ties to even
semeval_secondary.rank: Spearman with tied ranks averaged; constant input undefined

sensitivity_missing: retain each nonempty rating item; require both endings for paired update and more than one rating for within-SD accuracy
signed_update: later-sorting opaque ending ID minus earlier-sorting opaque ending ID, identical order across human means and model expectations; ending minus base reported separately
